controles.affirmation: Litige SPEX : jury de 316 M$ de dommages, 237 M$ d'interets, montant ramene a 1 $ symbolique en juin 2025, appel des deux parties, aucune provision
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q du 1er mai 2026 (data-lake/WDC/10Q/WDC_2026-05-01.htm.gz), note Legal Proceedings : « the jury awarded SPEX damages of $316 million... On January 8, 2025, the Court entered judgment for SPEX in accordance with the verdict and also awarded SPEX prejudgment interest of $237 million and legal costs. On June 16, 2025, the Court ruled on the Company's post-trial motions... awarded nominal damages of $1. On June 27, 2025, the Court entered an amended judgment awarding SPEX nominal damages of $1 with no prejudgment interest and no legal costs. The Company has appealed the infringement finding, and SPEX has appealed damages-related issues... has not accrued a liability ».

controles.affirmation: Conges fiscaux : Philippines et Thailande expirant a diverses dates entre 2026 et 2033 ; Malaisie expire le 1er novembre 2023, extension demandee ; assujettissement a l'impot minimum mondial
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : « tax holidays in the Philippines and Thailand that will expire at various dates during 2026 through 2033 » ; « On November 1, 2023, our tax holiday in Malaysia expired. We have applied for an extension and continue to be engaged in active discussions with the Malaysian Investment Development Authority ». 10-Q : « Effective tax rate 5% / 6% » ; « the gain on the retained interest in Sandisk being tax-free due to the Separation ».

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 1 : obligations convertibles 2028 inscrites 1 581 M$ au bilan pour une juste valeur de 12 507 M$, prix de conversion environ 37,72 $, capitaux propres 9 680 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q, tableau des instruments non comptabilises a la juste valeur : « 3.00% convertible notes due 2028 1,581 12,507 » ; note 7 Debt : « at a conversion price of approximately $37.72 per share of common stock as of April 3, 2026 » ; « outstanding $1.60 billion aggregate principal amount ». Capitaux propres 9 680 M$ presents au bilan.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 2 : 4 448 M$ de gain latent Sandisk sur 6 229 M$ de resultat net neuf mois (71%), retranche integralement du tableau de flux ; 1,7 million d'actions Sandisk restantes au 3 avril 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q : « Gain (loss) on retained interest in Sandisk 2,734 / 4,448 » ; resultat net neuf mois 6 229 M$ ; note 4 : « As of April 3, 2026, the Company still held 1.7 million shares of Sandisk common stock, which it expects to monetize by the end of 2026 ». 8-K du 11 juin 2026 : « an aggregate of 1,038,681 shares of common stock of Sandisk Corporation ».

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 3 : 545 M$ de couts d'echange dette contre actions au T3, dont 539 M$ de decote sur actions Sandisk liee a la volatilite du cours
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q, note 7 : « The exchange resulted in $539 million recorded in Costs in connection with debt-for-equity exchange... This amount primarily reflects a discount on Sandisk shares provided to the counterparties in connection with the exchange. The need for the discount was primarily driven by volatility of the Sandisk stock price. » Resultat operationnel du trimestre 1 190 M$ ; 545/1190 = 45,8%, coherent avec les 46% cites.

controles.affirmation: Echange de 858,4 M$ de principal d'obligations 2028 (2 juin 2026), reglement en cash du principal plus actions sur VWAP des 3 et 4 juin 2026 ; solde d'environ 710 M$ restant
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K du 3 juin 2026, Item 8.01 : « the holders have agreed to exchange approximately $858.4 million aggregate principal amount of Notes... using the volume-weighted average price of the Company's common stock over a two-day measurement period on June 3-4, 2026 ». Solde : 1 600 M$ emis moins 32 M$ deja convertis au T3 (10-Q note 7 : « aggregating to $32 million in principal amount ») moins 858,4 M$ = 709,6 M$. Arithmetique exacte.

controles.affirmation: Perimetre disques durs seuls en pertes en 2023 et 2024 : CA 6 255 / 6 317 / 9 520 M$, resultat operationnel (548) / (403) / 2 334, resultat net (902) / (765) / 1 643
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, tableau activites poursuivies : « Revenue, net $9,520 ... $6,317 ... $6,255 ... Operating income (loss) 2,334 (403) (548) ... Net income (loss) from continuing operations $1,643 $(765) $(902) ». Verbatim risque : « periods of excess capacity leading to our factories running below the desired utilization levels, resulting in us taking underutilization charges, inventory write-downs and reductions in ASPs » confirme.

controles.affirmation: Concentration : trois clients a 17%, 15% et 11% du CA au T3, top 10 a 71%, deux clients a 28% et 12% des creances, Cloud 89% du CA
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q : « For the three months ended April 3, 2026, three customers accounted for 17%, 15%, and 11% » ; « The Company's top 10 customers accounted for 71% and 74%, respectively, of its net revenue for the three and nine months ended April 3, 2026 » ; « Cloud revenue, representing 89% of total revenue ». 10-K : « As a result of the Separation, there is increased revenue concentration in our Cloud end market and among our top customers ».

controles.affirmation: Concurrence flash sur le Cloud et transition HAMR citee comme risque nomme
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : « Flash-based solutions also target our larger addressable market, i.e., Cloud » ; « the transition to areal density recording technologies that use heat-assisted magnetic recording ("HAMR") technology to increase HDD capacities » ; concurrents « Seagate Technology Holdings plc, and Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation ».
